title: Muon + PP + MTP: tied word_embeddings on MTP-only last PP stage routed to Muon instead of Adam
trigger_conditions: Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) enabled with last PP stage as MTP-only
root_cause: language_module.py setup_embeddings_and_output_layer() only sets is_embedding_or_output_parameter=True when self.pre_process is True. On MTP-only final PP stages where pre_process=False but the MTP module owns a tied word_embeddings replica, the parameter stays untagged. Muon's routing exclusion (skip params tagged is_embedding_or_output_parameter) overlooks the MTP replica and routes it to Muon, while PP rank 0's replica stays in AdamW. After every gradient all-reduce the two tied copies receive different optimizer updates (AdamW vs Muon Newton-Schulz), causing silent divergence and corrupted training.
invariant: Every word_embeddings.weight tensor across all PP stages MUST carry is_embedding_or_output_parameter=True (so Muon's exclusion rule routes it to AdamW).

expected_output.buggy: BUG DETECTED: word_embeddings.weight on MTP-only stage lacks is_embedding_or_output_parameter tag
expected_output.fixed: CLEAN: all word_embeddings tensors tagged is_embedding_or_output_parameter=True

reproduction_config.extra_flags: --position-embedding-type rope (MTP requires rope/none); tied embeddings = default (no --untie-embeddings-and-output-weights)
reproduction_config.muon_flags: not required for detection: invariant is set at model construction, before optimizer build

notes: Reproduced 2026-05-08 on eval-gpu-0. Buggy: 1/2 word_embeddings untagged on pp_rank=1 (MTP-only stage). Fixed: 2/2 tagged. Detection uses torch.distributed.all_gather_object inside patched setup_model_and_optimizer to avoid filesystem TOCTOU race between ranks. Old guidance about needing --share-embeddings-and-output-weights was stale: that flag was renamed to --untie-embeddings-and-output-weights (default = tied).
